description.zh: 待录制的频道所属app的id。该app需要归属于当前调用接口账号所属的主账号。
description.en: The ID of the app to which the channel to be recorded belongs. The app must belong to the primary account of the current API caller.

description.zh: 待录制的频道对应的id。需要确保调用本接口时，该频道内有用户，否则会创建录制任务失败。
description.en: The ID of the channel to be recorded. Ensure that the channel has active users when this operation is called. Otherwise, the recording task fails to be created.

description.zh:
空闲超时时间，当任务处于空闲状态的时长超过MaxIdleTime时，自动停止任务。单位为秒，范围须在[10,14400]内，即最大4小时。（默认为300秒）
- 对于混流录制模式，当所有订阅的用户流都停止推流时算作空闲
- 对于单流录制模式，订阅的流之间彼此独立，任意一路流停止推流都算作空闲，达到MaxIdleTime后会停止该路流的录制，当所有订阅流都空闲超时后，会停止整个云端录制任务。
description.en:
The idle timeout period. When the task remains idle for longer than MaxIdleTime, the task is automatically stopped. Unit: seconds. The value must be within the range of [10, 14400], which is a maximum of 4 hours. (Default value: 300 seconds)
- In stream mixing recording mode, the task is considered idle when all subscribed user streams stop stream ingest.
- In single-stream recording mode, subscribed streams are independent of each other. When any stream stops stream ingest, it is considered idle. After MaxIdleTime is reached, recording for that stream is stopped. When all subscribed streams have been idle beyond the timeout, the entire cloud recording task is stopped.

description.zh: 布局相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下期望录制出非纯音频文件时必填。
description.en: The layout parameters. This parameter is not required in single-stream recording mode. In stream mixing recording mode, this parameter is required when the recording output is expected to contain video.

description.zh: 转码相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下必填。
description.en: The transcoding parameters. This parameter is not required in single-stream recording mode and is required in stream mixing recording mode.

description.zh:
回调消息鉴权key，默认不填，即不做鉴权。如果填写，长度需要在[16,64]个字符内，且只由大小写英文字母和数字组成。
- 当NotifyUrl未填写时，NotifyAuthKey也无效。
- 当设置有效的NotifyAuthKey时，会在回调消息内携带鉴权内容。
description.en:
The authentication key for callback messages. If not specified, no authentication is performed. If specified, the length must be within [16, 64] characters and consist of only uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.
- If NotifyUrl is not specified, NotifyAuthKey is also invalid.
- When a valid NotifyAuthKey is set, authentication content is included in the callback message.

description.zh: 指定的格式，在触发录制文件生成事件（RecordFileUploaded）时，将发送回调消息。
description.en: The specified formats for which a callback message is sent when the recording file generation event (RecordFileUploaded) is triggered.

description.zh:
接受回调消息地址。任务状态消息会通过POST方式，以Json格式推送到该地址，最大长度不超过2048个字符。

回调消息说明参考[文档](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/live/on-cloud-recording-callback-message)。
description.en:
The URL for receiving callback messages. Task status messages are pushed to this URL in JSON format via POST. The maximum length is 2048 characters.

For callback message details, see [documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/live/on-cloud-recording-callback-message).

title.en: Start an RTC cloud recording task

descriptions.zh:
云端录制属于收费功能，收费详情请参见[云端录制费用](~~2976391~~)。
## 服务接入点
本接口可用的服务接入点包括：

  |地域名称 |地域ID | 公网接入地址 |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 上海 | cn-shanghai | live.aliyuncs.com |
  | 新加坡 | ap-southeast-1 | live.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com |
  | 美国（弗吉尼亚） | us-east-1 | live.us-east-1.aliyuncs.com |

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Cloud recording is a paid feature. For billing details, see [Cloud recording fees](~~2976391~~).
## Endpoints
The following endpoints are active for this operation:

  |Region |Region ID | Public endpoint |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Shanghai | cn-shanghai | live.aliyuncs.com |
  | Singapore | ap-southeast-1 | live.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com |
  | US (Virginia) | us-east-1 | live.us-east-1.aliyuncs.com |

## Rate limit
The individual user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation as needed.
